case_number: 2023 INSC 860; CIVIL APPELLATE JURISDICTION IA No 53466 of 2022 in Civil Appeal No 1867 of 2006

parties.respondent: U P Public Service Commission & Ors

summary: Jurisdictional dispute over judicial appointments; interpretation of existing service rules vs consensus recommendation; Haryana sought to bypass PSC under Punjab Civil Service (Judicial Branch) Rules 1951; Court rejected unilateral deviation from statutory recruitment framework; affirmed PSC's role with High Court oversight on question papers and evaluation; modification of 2009 order denied; State must conduct appointments per binding rules.
legal_provisions_cited: Punjab Civil Service (Judicial Branch) Rules 1951 Part C
final_judgment: Application dismissed; Haryana directed to conduct recruitment through PSC with High Court oversight as per existing rules; status quo maintained.
